hk-0VXM.title: Bus: mostly double-decker
hk-0VXM.summary: Mostly double-deckers with varied colours and ads; single-deckers are rarer. Minibuses have green or red roofs. Singapore also has double-deckers, usually light green.

differs.how: Singapore's double-deckers are often light green

hk-1TPi.title: Driving side: left
hk-1TPi.summary: Traffic drives on the left. Singapore also drives on the left, but Taiwan drives on the right.

hk-2RUz.title: Sign: give way, white triangle, thick red border
hk-2RUz.summary: Give way signs are a white upside-down triangle with a thick red border and text in two languages.

hk-3H1P.title: Pole: grey round lamp post, wide base
hk-3H1P.summary: Round grey lamp posts with a wide base. Many have a white sticker.

hk-54UR.title: Train: light rail with green-orange platforms
hk-54UR.summary: A light rail with green-and-orange platforms and single-level cars, on tracks separate from the street. It serves the north-west.

hk-7d4g.title: Houses: identical white and brown blocks
hk-7d4g.summary: Many identical white and brown apartment blocks and tall glass office buildings.

hk-9Br0.title: Houses: boxy, a few storeys, in small villages
hk-9Br0.summary: Boxy houses a few storeys high in small villages, mostly in the north.

hk-9S94.title: Tram: double-decker line on the north of the island
hk-9S94.summary: A double-decker tram runs along the north of the main island. Do not mix it up with the red railway, which has some above-ground sections.

hk-AEGS.title: Houses: crowded gridded streets, flats above shops
hk-AEGS.summary: Busy, crowded, gridded streets with apartments above shops. The buildings are older, so few glass walls, unlike parts of the main island.

hk-Bt5r.title: Pole: round wooden poles in rural areas only
hk-Bt5r.summary: No utility poles in cities. In the countryside you may see round wooden poles, single or double, with meters or transformers attached.

hk-EDC9.title: Landscape: green mountains, tall blocks nearby
hk-EDC9.summary: Outside the city it is mountainous with green subtropical plants and lots of rural roads. Tall apartment blocks are almost always close. Singapore is very flat.

hk-HC1Y.title: Sign: white rectangle, thick black border, two languages
hk-HC1Y.summary: Road signs are white rectangles with a thick black border and text in two languages.

hk-LeDC.title: Fire hydrant: red, round top, three outlets
hk-LeDC.summary: Mostly red hydrants with round tops and three outlets, plus a pipe-like version. Some are other colours, so check the shape.

hk-M4e3.title: Taxi: silver roof, green bumper stickers
hk-M4e3.summary: Mostly sedans, with silver roofs, green stickers on the bumpers and a roof sign. Red taxis are in the central city, green ones in the north, blue ones on the western island, though taxis travel everywhere.

hk-M67N.title: Houses: hilly, tall unique apartment towers
hk-M67N.summary: A residential area with hilly streets and tall modern apartment blocks that differ from each other.

hk-MfZN.title: Houses: extremely tall apartment blocks
hk-MfZN.summary: Very tall apartment buildings all over the city, much taller than in Singapore or Taiwan.

hk-Mg72.title: Houses: dense skyscraper city, busy streets
hk-Mg72.summary: Modern skyscrapers and busy streets full of cars and people. The city feel alone usually identifies urban areas.

hk-MmJq.title: Landmark: shiny cylindrical terminal, triangle windows
hk-MmJq.summary: A shiny, cylinder-shaped cruise terminal with triangular windows on the side. Seen from a highway and a bypass in the east.

hk-My9n.title: Bridge: cable-stayed, no yellow, box guardrail
hk-My9n.summary: Similar to the previous bridge but with no yellow paint and a box-beam guardrail instead of cable-style rails.

hk-NHOZ.title: Road: divided, river on the west, palm median
hk-NHOZ.summary: A divided road heading north-east with a river on the west, palms in the median and a bike path alongside. Further north a similar road with more lanes also follows the river.

hk-NOdn.title: Bins: bright orange on sidewalks
hk-NOdn.summary: Bright orange bins stand on sidewalks.

hk-ODqH.title: Bridge: very long sea bridge, black-yellow barriers
hk-ODqH.summary: A very long bridge reaching into the horizon over the ocean. The road beside it has black and yellow concrete barriers.

hk-OWYV.title: Landscape: flat rice paddies, skyline to the north
hk-OWYV.summary: A mostly flat north-west area with waterlogged rice paddies. A big city skyline appears in the distance to the north.

hk-PTPi.title: Coverage: black guardrail, skyline view, tourists
hk-PTPi.summary: A walking path with a distinct black guardrail, a skyline view and tourists. It circles a famous peak.

hk-Qc6r.title: Road lines: yellow pedestrian crossings
hk-Qc6r.summary: Pedestrian crossings are painted yellow, and some junctions have yellow grids.

hk-RHZ1.title: Coverage: coastal region next to a big mainland
hk-RHZ1.summary: A special region in southern China, bordering Guangdong province. For country streaks it counts as China.

hk-YcI3.title: Road: divided, palms, teal street lamps
hk-YcI3.summary: Divided roads with palm trees along the side and teal-coloured street lamps. They lead to a theme park.

hk-a40M.title: Houses: wall-mounted air conditioners
hk-a40M.summary: Air conditioners bolted to apartment walls are very common because of the subtropical climate.

hk-cYCy.title: Language: English and traditional Chinese
hk-cYCy.summary: English sits next to traditional Chinese characters on bilingual signs. People mostly speak Cantonese.

hk-exTo.title: Guardrail: grey pedestrian rails, no striped kerbs
hk-exTo.summary: Striped kerbs are almost never seen, unlike in Singapore where they are extremely common. Grey pedestrian guardrails are common.

differs.how: Singapore has very common striped kerbs

hk-glk8.title: Houses: dense skyscrapers, luxury stores
hk-glk8.summary: Lots of modern skyscrapers, a busy, rich, well-kept feel and many luxury brand shops and ads. It is the central business district.

hk-hNWm.title: Landmark: two skyscrapers to tell the harbour sides
hk-hNWm.summary: One tower is on the island side, the other on the mainland side. The mainland-side tower is boxier with no vertical window frames. The island-side tower is rounder with visible vertical frames.

hk-hZST.title: Landscape: weathered rock walls with nets
hk-hZST.summary: Weathered rock cuts on mountainsides, some covered by nets against rockslides. Green or blue plaques are common.

hk-ixNM.title: Plate: white front, yellow rear
hk-ixNM.summary: White front plates and yellow rear plates, long or short. Some cars carry an extra black mainland Chinese plate.

hk-jvPq.title: Bridge: suspension, ladder towers, yellow-red rails
hk-jvPq.summary: The only big suspension bridge. It has two ladder-like towers and yellow and red guardrails.

hk-m242.title: Bollard: yellow with white arrow in blue circle
hk-m242.summary: Yellow bollards with a white arrow in a blue circle, mostly at pedestrian crossings, showing where cars should go. Flat and box-shaped versions exist.

hk-nGo8.title: Coverage: car-free islands, narrow streets
hk-nGo8.summary: Three small islands with walking-backpack coverage: no cars, narrow streets and rural buildings. One of them is the hilliest.

hk-nmVf.title: Road: skylines on both sides, clean
hk-nmVf.summary: The island skyline to the south and the mainland skyline to the north, in good condition with clean sidewalks.

hk-oyjs.title: Bridge: cable-stayed, three round towers, yellow paint
hk-oyjs.summary: A newer-looking cable-stayed bridge with clean asphalt, three round towers, cables attached directly to the towers, and yellow paint in the median and edges.

hk-sZbs.title: Houses: identical blocks in a wall, palm trees
hk-sZbs.summary: Identical apartment blocks all facing the same way like a wall, with lots of planted palms between them and beside the roads.

hk-u3t8.title: Road: like the narrow jungle road but busier
hk-u3t8.summary: Similar to the narrow jungle road but runs east-west, is busier with more houses, wider, and has a tree median by the villages.

hk-uuVB.title: Road: narrow, dense jungle, no edge lines
hk-uuVB.summary: A narrow road with dense tropical vegetation, sometimes mountains behind, and no edge lines. Small villages branch off it.

hk-vDus.title: Road lines: white centre, white or yellow edges
hk-vDus.summary: White centre lines with white or yellow edge lines, single, double or dashed. Roads are often concrete. Yellow edge lines on small roads mean no stopping.

hk-yCNY.title: Coverage: big construction and many bridges
hk-yCNY.summary: Large construction works and many bridges connecting other parts of the territory to the two islands.
